trail-garden.title: TRAIL - Modular Garden
trail-garden.description: A modular gardening system inspired by chinampas and natural fractals.

smart-mold.title: GHOST - Digitally Reconfigurable Mold
smart-mold.description: GHOST is a proof of concept, aiming to digitally control “smart fluidˮ to create instant reconfigurable molds from 3D mesh files for hobbyist manufacturing, capable of evolving into an industrial manufacturing process.

duo-msd.title: DUO - Modular Stationery Device
duo-msd.description: DUO is a modular stationery system for makers & creatives. The structure is inspired by Japanese wood joinery which enables the connection of different tools depending on a users needs. It is an adaptable, versatile and evolving system.
